model.description: Input LS-DYNA K-file (or 'input'). *INCLUDE files are followed and inlined into the output.

output.description: Output K-file. Defaults to the input name with an '_extracted' suffix.

parts.description: PIDs to extract. A PID that is not in the deck is refused rather than silently producing an empty deck. Either this or part_titles is required.

part_titles.description: Part title patterns with '*' and '?' wildcards, matched case-insensitively against the *PART title line. A pattern that matches nothing is refused.

renumber.description: Renumber nodes and elements from 1 and write <output>_renumber_map.json with the old-to-new pairs. Only field 0 of each line is rewritten in place, so coordinate text is preserved byte for byte. Refused when two element families share an element ID.

verify.description: Read the written deck back and report undefined nodes, parts, sections and materials. Non-zero exit if any.

include.nodes.description: Carry the *NODE lines the extracted elements use.

include.sets.description: referenced trims *SET_NODE / *SET_PART / *SET_SOLID / *SET_SHELL / *SET_TSHELL to what the output contains and keeps *SET_SEGMENT faces whose four nodes all survive. Variants whose members cannot be read as IDs (_GENERATE, _GENERAL, _ADD, _INTERSECT) are dropped and their SIDs listed.

include.materials.description: Carry *MAT_*, *EOS_*, *HOURGLASS blocks the chosen parts name, plus *DEFINE_CURVE and *DEFINE_TABLE (pure numbers, no node references). A block holding several definitions is carried whole and counted.

include.sections.description: Carry the *SECTION_* blocks the chosen parts name.

report.description: Write the result as JSON: selected parts, picked counts, needed section/material IDs, sets trimmed and dropped, dropped keywords, renumber map path and the read-back verification.

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
